headword: {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}

definitions.explanation: A work of fiction that is shorter than a novel, typically focusing on a single plot or theme. Generally under about 100 pages.

examples.japanese: {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: This author excels at short stories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}{集|しゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}→文学賞：22097_bungakushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Her collection of short stories won a literary prize.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧ (short piece) + ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (novel, fiction). Refers to fictional prose that is significantly shorter than a novel, usually focused on a single episode or theme.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}{集|しゅう}: short story collection
- {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a short story
- {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a short story

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{長編小説|ちょうへんしょうせつ}→長編小説：20799_chouhenshousetsu⟧: full-length novel
- {中編小説|ちゅうへんしょうせつ}: novella, medium-length fiction
- {掌編小説|しょうへんしょうせつ}: flash fiction, very short story
- ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧: short piece (can refer to short stories, films, etc.)

USAGE:
Often abbreviated to just ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧ in conversation when the context makes it clear that fiction is being discussed.
